set.body:
Work key: L01.6
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Prepare reviewable repository documentation for demonstrating value and discussing a later pilot; no external messages or publication are implied.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Write an artifact-matched local quickstart, prerequisite/account/data inventory, start/stop/reset instructions, troubleshooting and teardown; rehearse every command from a fresh environment.
2. Provide a presenter narrative and researcher/curator guide using actual qualified screenshots and normal product tasks, with a clean demonstration reset and reproducible example outputs.
3. Prepare a concise architecture/access/recovery/evidence/limits pack and pilot discussion questions; clearly separate local engineering results from missing institutional approval, data permission, real-provider and human/operator acceptance.

Verification: Guide-only clean-environment rehearsal, checked command/link/screenshot inventory and versioned discussion pack with local acceptance evidence.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.6/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md

Blocked by:
- L01.5: bd-01M4X5MAF3ZKCM0TKD58Z7M0MP

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: L01.6: Publish the local quickstart, user guide and institutional discussion pack
